traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Heliconiaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins pinnate; blades oblong; leaf rosettes basal or none; plants hermaphrodite; ovary inferior; stems herbaceous; flowers in panicles; flowers zygomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit drupe or berry; parts of each whorl 3; stamens 5; carpels 3.
